cases.reason: Scope: the first print line position rules of all five tables, paged and unpaged. (a) The pointer does not state the whole 1985 scope: 1985 body rule 4b places the first body group on a page at LINE-COUNTER+1 when LINE-COUNTER >= FIRST DETAIL (the saved-next-group-integer path), while the pointer GR5 b3 sends the first body group on a page to the FIRST DETAIL integer; that arm is stated in 2023 only by GR-13.18.37.4-4 a3, which is not in `to`. (b) The witness: GR5's at-85 cases (pb484, pb1247) are both UNPAGED, so they exercise only the unpaged arms (RH 3d, body 4d, RF 3d); no paged arm (HEADING+n-1, PH after RH at LC+n, FIRST DETAIL, PF absolute, RF after PF) is exercised by the pointer at 85. The read's evidence 'paged and unpaged' is not what those cases show. The compiler is correct on all of it: probe s-17-refute/paged_first_line_lc_85.cob at --std 85 prints P1 L04 RH, L05 PH, L07 D1A, P2 L03 PH, P3 L09 D1A (saved integer 8, then 8+1), P3 L18 RF (PF at 16, +2), exactly the 1985 table rules.
